data.why: The repository bundles two small synthetic datasets built for the Import CSV tab, one for single measurements and one for the full Schlumberger field sheet; both are copied verbatim for the browser to upload.

goals: Enter a single VES measurement (ΔV, I, K, units) and read off the apparent resistivity with unit-aware conversion and quality warnings
Import a CSV of field measurements and verify they parse into the measurement table without ambiguous-value or unit errors
Fill in the digital Field sheet (VES) with AB/2 and MN spacing to get a Schlumberger K and the log-log resistivity-vs-spacing curve
Import the synthetic Excel pt-BR field sheet CSV and inspect overlap readings, a repeated reading, and an excluded reading with its reason
Export the results as CSV (standard or Excel pt-BR) and confirm the round trip preserves the data
Generate the VES report (PDF or HTML) summarizing survey details, the curve, readings, warnings, and change history

review.summary: The tree is accurate and well structured. Its goal, phases and 11 features follow the README pipeline from single readings and the K calculator through import, the field sheet with pooling/exclusion/CV, the curve, history, figure, report and project save, and all eleven screens I opened match their nodes. It needs fixes before filing: it never shows a sounding typed into a blank sheet, an exclusion made by the user, input validation, or opening/restoring a project, and f11 should be split.
